title: Bowling Strike
blurb: Ball down the lane, then the clatter of pins going everywhere — a strike compressed into a second and a bit. Bowling alleys are one of the few places left with a genuinely distinctive acoustic signature: hard maple, low ceilings and a crash with a long rattling tail. That tail is exactly why the clip is so useful in edits. It reads as things collapsing rather than merely pins falling, so it works over anything from a knocked-over drink to a plan coming apart. Streamers bind it as a fail alert for precisely that reason.
origin: A bowling ball striking pins, recorded in a lane.
